instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Reading the abstracts should bring the list down to about (27) ........ studies.
items.evidence: Screen the abstracts down to roughly thirty studies.
items.explanation: Eighty-six is the number of results the search the librarian tried that morning returned in the first database; after screening abstracts, about thirty studies are expected to remain.

items.prompt: Reasons for rejecting an item have to be written on the (28) ........ from the module page.
items.evidence: There's a screening sheet on the module page — use it, and write down why you rejected each item.
items.explanation: The librarian asks for the screening sheet on the module page to be used, with the reason for rejecting each source written down.

items.prompt: In the reference software the students should set up a (29) ........ so that their records all go to the same place.
items.evidence: set up a group library so you're both adding to the same one
items.explanation: Reference management software is suggested instead of a shared folder; they need to set up a group library so that both of them add to the same place.

items.prompt: No more than (30) ........ can be downloaded from a database in one go.
items.evidence: Two hundred records at a time, that's the limit.
items.explanation: The export process is limited to two hundred records at a time; the librarian gives this along with the reminder to save the search.
